keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: Robot learning and world models
themes.summary: The papers develop embodied robot learning around world-action models, vision-language-action policies, and humanoid/loco-manipulation control, often using 3D geometry, video generation, or latent world models to improve action prediction. They differ in whether they build compact latent predictors, reuse pretrained video/VLM backbones, add safety or memory modules, or contribute benchmarks, datasets, and hardware for manipulation and navigation.

themes.name: Scientific machine learning and simulation
themes.summary: The papers develop machine-learning surrogates, emulators, and generative models for expensive scientific simulation and design, spanning cosmology, climate, molecular conformation, particle physics, materials, and engineering. They differ in architecture and physical priors—flow matching, neural operators, physics-informed networks, and autoencoders—and in whether they emphasize interpretability, uncertainty, or closed-loop validation.

themes.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and agent memory
themes.summary: These papers examine retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented LLM agents, focusing on how evidence is selected, stored, routed, and verified across documents, graphs, and long-term interactions. They differ by targeting chunking and context budgets, graph traversal and provenance, knowledge conflicts and stale memories, and domain deployments such as public administration and finance.

themes.name: Coding agents and GUI grounding
themes.summary: The papers evaluate LLM and coding agents across software engineering, GUI interaction, infrastructure, testing, and safety-critical domains. They differ by introducing domain-specific benchmarks and harnesses, memory and context architectures, verification and review frameworks, and empirical studies of agent behavior and limitations.

themes.name: Reinforcement learning and verifiable rewards
themes.summary: The papers develop and analyze reinforcement learning methods across control, bandits, digital health, and LLM post-training, with a shared emphasis on robust exploration, optimization stability, and deployment constraints. They differ in whether they propose new algorithms, libraries, or empirical analyses, and in domains ranging from rocket landing and wind-farm control to video reasoning and combinatorial semi-bandits.

themes.name: LLM safety, security, and watermarking
themes.summary: The papers study safety, security, privacy, and fairness failures in LLM/VLM systems, including prompt injection against tool-using agents, system prompt leakage, harmful-prompt detection, watermarking, and safety alignment for low-resource languages. They differ in whether they propose auditing/detection methods, build datasets and runtime guardrails, or analyze internal mechanisms behind failures and weak oversight. Across these angles, the theme centers on verifying model behavior and constraining agent actions under adversarial or deployment pressure.

themes.name: Medical imaging and clinical foundation models
themes.summary: The papers develop and evaluate deep learning methods for clinical tasks spanning medical imaging, decision support, and treatment planning, with attention to reliability, interpretability, and multimodal fusion. They differ in whether they introduce benchmarks, compare architectures or pretraining strategies, or propose task-specific models for detection, grading, segmentation, registration, and forecasting.

themes.name: Generative and sequential recommendation
themes.summary: The papers build and analyze recommender systems across sequential, generative, and multimodal settings, with emphasis on ranking, CTR, explanation, and LLM-agent evaluation. They differ in whether they improve representation and routing, semantic-ID generation, robustness under storage or sampling constraints, or empirical reproducibility and evaluation.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow matching generative models
themes.summary: The papers develop diffusion and flow-based generative models, spanning theory (score-matching variance, Brownian interpolant sampling bounds), efficient sampling and distillation for few-step or one-step generation, diffusion language models with temporal self-conditioning and budget-aware distillation, and guidance/optimal-control methods. They differ in whether they target mathematical guarantees, training or decoding efficiency, or domain applications such as video restoration, HDR imaging, face swapping, and closed-loop driving. A recurring concern is preserving quality, diversity, or safety when accelerating or constraining generation.

themes.name: 3D Gaussian splatting and reconstruction
themes.summary: These papers develop 3D reconstruction and representation methods spanning feed-forward geometry models, Gaussian-splatting SLAM and scene editing, point-cloud registration, human mesh recovery, and occupancy prediction. They differ in whether they improve camera generality, tracking and mapping robustness, semantic or part-level grounding, privacy, or physically consistent insertion, and several introduce measurement protocols or new benchmarks. A common thread is combining learned priors with explicit geometric constraints to improve consistency and reliability.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference and quantization
themes.summary: The papers target efficient LLM inference and training by compressing weights, activations, KV caches, tokens, and expert channels, or by reducing communication in distributed decoding. Methods range from calibration-based residual corrections and learned codecs to workload-aware cache policies and pruning analyses. They differ mainly in intervention stage and whether they optimize accuracy, memory, latency, or communication under fixed budgets.

themes.name: Multi-agent LLM collaboration and debate
themes.summary: The papers develop and evaluate multi-agent LLM systems across debate, collaboration, handoffs, profiling, and domain applications. They differ in whether they propose new frameworks, benchmarks, or protocols, and in how they test coordination, evidence grounding, and agent behavior.

highlights.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
highlights.authors: Jiayi Luo, Yang Zhang, Liliang Chen et al.
highlights.why: Reframes world models as counterfactual engines with rollback and branching, supported by a scalable self-reinforcing real-robot/system cycle, a potentially high-impact paradigm for policy improvement.
highlights.key_result: Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

highlights.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
highlights.authors: Qiaoling Chen, Jiaxiang Cheng, Xueqing Deng et al.
highlights.why: Releases an 8B interactive video world model supporting free-form instructions and camera control with causal attention and curriculum training, advancing world generation capabilities.
highlights.key_result: The paper presents Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns, and reports that in human evaluation it shows superior performance over existing world models.
evidence: We present Hy-Nomas , a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns.
Our evaluation demonstrates that Hy-Nomas is superior to existing world models across a range of interactive tasks.

highlights.title: ASTROLABE: A 3D Particle-Level Surrogate for Cosmology Simulation with Physical Flow Matching
highlights.authors: Ibrahim Elsharkawy, David Curtin, Yonatan Kahn et al.
highlights.why: Introduces a particle-level flow-matching emulator that removes voxel-resolution ceilings and can in principle produce any cosmological observable, widening emulator applicability.
highlights.key_result: astrolabe is a generative emulator which is trained on 1500 distinct DMO N-body simulations, 100,000 redshift snapshots, and 200 billion individual particles. It is also capable of being fine-tuned to simulate very large N, and we demonstrate this by emulating a TNG50-3-dark simulation at a fraction of the cost.

highlights.title: Who Convinced Whom? Tracing How LLMs Change Their Minds in Multi-Agent Systems
highlights.authors: Arnesh Batra, Aniket Khandelwal, Jashn Khemani et al.
highlights.why: Uses controlled interventions to show debate can change answers through peer influence rather than independent corroboration, questioning reliability of multi-agent agreement.
highlights.key_result: Debate yields only small estimated accuracy improvements over initial majority voting on fully parsed, reference-labelled non-numeric questions, while increasing the rate of unanimous wrong answers by 3.1–7.4 percentage points relative to reflection; after twelve rounds three debating agents carried the error-correcting weight of only 1.02–1.07 independent voters versus 1.70–2.10 under reflection.

Relative to compute-matched majority voting, debate improved accuracy by about one percentage point on Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-E4B and by an inconclusive margin on Llama-3.1-8B, while increasing wrong unanimity above reflection by 3.1--7.4 points in every model. highlights.authors: Marco Paina, Mark Niklas Muller, Niels Mundler-Sasahara et al.
highlights.why: Benchmark of real maintainer-fixed bugs shows frontier agents have low recall/precision and find different bug distributions, challenging assumptions about proactive bug discovery.
highlights.key_result: Across frontier models, coding agents tasked with whole-repository bug discovery all achieve a recall of below 21% and a precision of less than 9% with respect to the reference set of maintainer-fixed bugs; stronger models increase recall substantially from 8% to 17% but do not improve precision.

highlights.title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
highlights.authors: Yuvraj Sehgal, Mahsa Panahandeh, Naser Ezzati-Jivan
highlights.why: Empirically uncovers hidden tool-output truncation in an agent harness even when context is underused, with direct accuracy consequences, a cautionary result for agent builders.
highlights.key_result: In a real tool-using agent, the context window was almost empty—across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it—yet 3,827 of 11,189 tool results were cut before reaching the model, and every cut result became broken JSON. A controlled experiment showed the cut's real cost appears first as extra work, not as wrong answers: 43% more tool calls, twice the computation, and yield falling from 0.61 to 0.31.

highlights.title: Any3R: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Any Camera Type
highlights.authors: Jingong Chen, Qingwen Zhang, Youming Deng et al.
highlights.why: Removes pinhole assumptions by conditioning on dense ray fields, enabling feed-forward reconstruction from arbitrary central cameras, a significant practical advance.
highlights.key_result: Any3R is therefore a feed-forward model that takes any central camera, and is robust to mixing many camera types per scene, with no retraining per lens. On a benchmark of thirteen central cameras across three datasets, where every method reconstructs with its own predicted camera poses, it is the most consistently accurate method.

OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and building new Oracle products on OpenAI models, including Oracle AI Workspace, AI Security Mesh, AI SMB Bundle, and App Composer. Oracle reported 130,000 active ChatGPT users and more than 95,000 active Codex users, and its recruiting team cut market research preparation from two to four days to 15–20 minutes; U.S. customers can buy OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work access via Oracle Marketplace.

news.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
news.summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a natively multimodal world model that generates audio, ambient noise, and dialogue alongside interactive simulation, built on Gemini family models including Gemini Omni. It is rolling out as a research preview to trusted testers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

news.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
news.summary: Google Research introduced a "sleep" framework for continual learning in which LLMs alternate between an active wake phase and an offline sleep phase that consolidates short-term context into parameters via MoE expansion, knowledge seeding, and self-generated practice examples. The authors report the approach lets models acquire new facts, retain long-context knowledge up to 10M tokens, and improve reasoning while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

news.title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
news.summary: NVIDIA describes its collaboration with C-BRAIN, a consortium of 18 institutions launched in November 2025 and led by Dr. Randall Bateman, which uses AI on previously inaccessible "dark data" for Alzheimer's research, running 64 NVIDIA data center GPUs on premises plus Azure cloud nodes, with Blackwell systems planned. C-BRAIN has built two tools, OpenScientist (with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory) and InsightEngine (with 387 Labs), targeting the 57 million people living with dementia worldwide.

news.title: Memory-Enforced GPU Sharing in Kubernetes with NVIDIA CUDA 13.4
news.summary: NVIDIA released gpu-fractioning, an open-source Kubernetes operator hosted under the KAI Scheduler organization, which runs alongside the NVIDIA GPU Operator to configure MPS per node, apply per-workload memory limits and compute modes, and measure per-fraction usage. CUDA 13.4 adds transparent memory boundary enforcement with exact amounts, guaranteed-minimum/burstable-maximum ranges, and a choice of time-slicing or sm-sharing modes, integrated via KAI Scheduler v0.18.0's NvFractions mode.

news.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced RTX Spark, a Windows PC platform combining a Blackwell RTX GPU and Grace CPU with up to 128 GB of unified memory, aimed at AI development, creation, and gaming in slim laptops and compact desktops. It supports DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering starting with NBA 2K27, an October model update that runs 2x faster than September with 20% less VRAM at 4K, and the Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB model for local AI characters.

news.title: Fine-Tuning NVIDIA Nemotron to Know Local Rules, Not Just Local Languages
news.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron-Personas datasets for France (with Pleias) and Belgium (with Pleias and KU Leuven), synthetic residents grounded in regional demographics and culture, part of a data program covering 12 countries. The accompanying workflow generates synthetic conversations and fine-tunes Nemotron 3.5 Lightning with LoRA on NVIDIA NeMo; Pleias uses the datasets in its Lamina spine-care assistant.

news.title: 3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA benchmarks three optimizations for serving Ling-3.0-flash, a 124-billion-parameter MoE model with 5.1 billion active parameters per token, at batch size 1 on DGX Spark: Humming MXFP4 MoE kernels (27.71 ms to 25.35 ms per output token, 9.3% gain), online FP8 quantization of the LM head (21.7% combined with Humming), and NEXTN speculative decoding (3.90 accepted tokens per round, 185.1% gain). Together on GSM8K they raised decode throughput 42.5% and cut mean latency 24.5% with no statistically detectable accuracy change.

news.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
news.summary: Liquid AI's LFM3 is a new generation of foundation models spanning text, vision, audio, omni, and decision models in the 2B parameter range, all trained from LFM3-1.7B-Base, with LFM3-1.7B reported to outperform LFM2.5-2.6B while using 35% fewer parameters. The base model was pre-trained on 22T tokens with a 256K context window, fits in about 1 GB at 4-bit, and fine-tunes on a single GPU; a new 164M-parameter vision encoder uses 2.2x fewer FLOPs than Qwen3.5-2B's.

news.title: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
news.summary: Ai2 released Old Ideas, Novel Problems, a study and benchmark testing whether LLMs can judge research idea novelty, built from ICLR 2026 peer reviews into a 154-idea high-novelty pool and a 145-idea lower-novelty pool. Across six judges (GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Opus 4.6), small prompt changes shifted accuracy by more than 50 percentage points, retrieval and added reasoning did not consistently help, and two purpose-built novelty systems underperformed a simple prompted Claude Opus 4.6 baseline.

news.title: AWS named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contact Center as a Service
news.summary: AWS announced that Amazon Connect was named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contact Center as a Service for the fourth consecutive year. The post describes Connect Customer's use of generative and agentic AI for customer context and resolution, with auditable actions and human handoff.

news.title: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs
news.summary: AWS announced Seekable OCI (SOCI) indexing for Amazon SageMaker AI Training and processing jobs, which lazy-loads container images so jobs start in seconds rather than minutes without changes to job definitions. In benchmarks across eight images of 1.8–35.4 GB compressed on instances from ml.g4dn to ml.p5 and ml.m7i, GPU idle time during image pulls fell by up to 90 percent.

news.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Property Finder and the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center describe fixing evaluation bias on Amazon Bedrock, where 96.8 percent of evaluation labels came from the incumbent vision model's predictions rather than human verification, skewing comparisons. After building expert-annotated ground truth (a 256-image development set) and running prompt optimization from v0 to v27, they report higher accuracy at 86 percent lower cost.

news.title: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization
news.summary: Exowatt used Amazon SageMaker AI serverless model customization to build a repeatable pipeline producing task-specific fine-tuned models for edge and cloud alarm triage, reporting higher accuracy than frontier models at up to 49x lower cost. The pipeline, which turns raw operational data into a certified training set, fine-tuned model, and evaluated deployment artifact, now runs in days rather than months.

highlights.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
highlights.authors: Jiayi Luo, Yang Zhang, Liliang Chen et al.
highlights.why: 将世界模型重新构建为具有 Rollback 和分支的反事实引擎，并由可扩展的自我强化真实机器人/系统循环所支撑，这是一种可能具有高影响力的策略改进范式。
highlights.key_result: 在三个具有挑战性的真实世界任务上的实验表明，Rollback 在方块提取、抛球和桌面冰壶上分别将成功率相对最强基线绝对提高了 10.67%、11.11% 和 11.85%，同时在整个训练过程中实现了更稳定的提升。尽管从远低于人类水平的遥操作演示开始初始化，Rollback 在 8 小时的训练内就在抛球和桌面冰壶上超过了人类玩家的平均成功率。
evidence: Experiments on three challenging real-world tasks show that Rollback improves success rates over the strongest baseline by an absolute 10.67%, 11.11%, and 11.85% on block extraction, ball tossing, and tabletop curling, respectively, while achieving more stable improvement throughout training. Although initialized from teleoperated demonstrations far below human level, Rollback surpasses the average success rate of human players on both ball tossing and tabletop curling within 8 hours of training.

highlights.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
highlights.authors: Qiaoling Chen, Jiaxiang Cheng, Xueqing Deng et al.
highlights.why: 发布了一个 8B 交互式视频世界模型，支持自由形式指令和相机控制，具备因果注意力和课程训练，从而推进了世界生成能力。
highlights.key_result: 该论文提出了 Hy-Nomas，一个具有 8B 扩散主干网络的视频世界模型，支持在多轮交互中提供自由形式文本指令和连续相机控制，并报告在人工评估中它表现出优于现有世界模型的性能。
evidence: We present Hy-Nomas , a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns.
Our evaluation demonstrates that Hy-Nomas is superior to existing world models across a range of interactive tasks.

highlights.title: ASTROLABE: A 3D Particle-Level Surrogate for Cosmology Simulation with Physical Flow Matching
highlights.authors: Ibrahim Elsharkawy, David Curtin, Yonatan Kahn et al.
highlights.why: 引入了一种粒子级 flow matching 模拟器，它消除了体素分辨率上限，原则上可以生成任何宇宙学观测量，从而扩大了模拟器的适用性。
highlights.key_result: astrolabe 是一个生成式模拟器，在 1500 个不同的 DMO N 体模拟、100,000 个红移快照和 200 billion 个独立粒子上训练而成。它还能够通过微调来模拟非常大的 N，我们通过以极低的成本模拟 TNG50-3-dark 模拟来证明这一点。
evidence: In this paper, we introduce astrolabe ( A Scalable Transport for Resolved c Osmological LArge- Body Emulation) The name backronyms the astrolabe (from the Greek astrolabos, ``star-taker''), the analog computer that compressed the hours of trigonometry needed to compute positions of the stars , a parallel with astrolabe's purpose of speeding up cosmology simulation. Further, the instrument began as a large, single-latitude, narrow-purpose device built on the work of Hipparchus and Ptolemy and was later transformed by medieval astronomers such as al-Fazari, al-Sufi, and al-Zarqali , who shrank the device to fit in a pocket , and increased its use far beyond reading the sky . Similarly, where previous emulators often are single-observable and/or impractical to scale, we intend for astrolabe to be a compact model, useful for extracting many observables across redshifts, dark matter models, and box sizes while remaining scalable to large particle counts., a generative emulator which is trained on 1500 distinct DMO N-body simulations, 100,000 redshift snapshots, and 200 billion individual particles.
astrolabe is also capable of being fine-tuned to simulate very large N, and we demonstrate this by emulating a TNG50-3-dark simulation at a fraction of the cost.

highlights.title: Who Convinced Whom? Tracing How LLMs Change Their Minds in Multi-Agent Systems
highlights.authors: Arnesh Batra, Aniket Khandelwal, Jashn Khemani et al.
highlights.why: 通过受控干预表明，辩论可以通过同伴影响而非独立佐证来改变答案，从而质疑多智能体一致性的可靠性。
highlights.key_result: Debate 在完全解析、带有参考标签的非数字问题上，相较初始多数投票仅带来很小的估计准确率提升，同时相对于反思使一致错误答案的比例增加了 3.1–7.4 个百分点；在十二轮之后，三个辩论智能体仅承担 1.02–1.07 个独立投票者的纠错权重，而反思下为 1.70–2.10。
evidence: On fully parsed, reference-labelled non-numeric questions, debate yields small estimated accuracy improvements over initial majority voting, while increasing the rate of unanimous wrong answers by 3.1–7.4 percentage points relative to reflection. Longer debates show persistent consensus and greater correlation between agents’ correctness than reflection.

Relative to compute-matched majority voting, debate improved accuracy by about one percentage point on Qwen3.5-9B and Gemma-4-E4B and by an inconclusive margin on Llama-3.1-8B, while increasing wrong unanimity above reflection by 3.1--7.4 points in every model. After twelve rounds, three debating agents had the error-correcting weight of only 1.02--1.07 independent voters, versus 1.70--2.10 under reflection.

highlights.title: Let the Gate Decide: Per-Lookup Precision for Quantized Conditional Memory in LLMs
highlights.authors: Tianqi Chen, Xunchao Li, Linchuan Xie et al.
highlights.why: 发现基于频率的细化比随机更差，并利用门控加权误差将 GPU 表内存削减 7.8x，同时保持精度，这是一个反直觉且实用的结果。
highlights.key_result: 在不重新训练的情况下，GateRQ 将 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 上的 GPU 表内存削减了 7.8，这使得 vLLM 吞吐量相对于 FP8 表提高了 11%--31%，同时在两个模型上以每次查找读取 1.50 bits 时损失约 1 个 PopQA 分数，在 2.10 bits 时损失 0.2 分。
evidence: Without retraining, GateRQ cuts GPU table memory by 7.8 on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, which raises vLLM throughput by 11%--31% over FP8 tables, while losing about 1 PopQA point at 1.50 bits read per lookup and 0.2 points at 2.10 bits across two models.
with TCQ it is within 0.2 PopQA points of FP8 at 2.10 bits, while cutting DeepSeek's table memory from 23.6 to 3.0 GiB per GPU and raising vLLM throughput by 11%--31% over FP8 tables in GPU memory.

highlights.title: PROBE: Frontier Coding Agents Find Different Bugs Than Maintainers Fix
highlights.authors: Marco Paina, Mark Niklas Muller, Niels Mundler-Sasahara et al.
highlights.why: 基于真实维护者修复缺陷的基准测试表明，前沿智能体的召回率/精确率较低，并且发现的缺陷分布不同，质疑了关于主动缺陷发现的假设。
highlights.key_result: 在各类前沿模型中，负责全仓库缺陷发现的编码智能体相对于维护者修复缺陷的参考集，召回率均低于 21%，精确率均低于 9%；更强的模型将召回率从 8% 大幅提高到 17%，但并未提高精确率。
evidence: We evaluate coding agents across frontier models and find they all achieve a recall of below 21% and a precision of less than 9% with respect to the reference set.
While stronger models increase recall substantially from 8% to 17%, they do not improve precision.

We compare different models in tab:lane_summary ( app:repo-recall) and observe that all agents recover only a small share of the historical bugs, with even the best run achieving less than 21% recall and at most 8.1% precision.

highlights.title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
highlights.authors: Yuvraj Sehgal, Mahsa Panahandeh, Naser Ezzati-Jivan
highlights.why: 实证揭示了智能体 harness 中隐藏的工具输出截断，即使在上下文未充分利用时也会发生，并直接带来准确性后果，这对智能体构建者是一个警示性结果。
highlights.key_result: 在一个真实的工具使用智能体中，上下文窗口几乎为空——在 720 次运行中，单个最大提示仅使用了其中的 5.75%——然而 11,189 个工具结果中有 3,827 个在到达模型之前被截断，且每个被截断的结果都变成损坏的 JSON。对照实验表明，截断的真实代价首先表现为额外工作，而不是错误答案：工具调用增加 43%，计算量翻倍，产出从 0.61 下降到 0.31。
evidence: The context window was almost empty: across 720 runs, the single largest prompt used only 5.75% of it. Yet a third of all tool results (3,827 of 11,189) were cut before they reached the model, and every cut result became broken JSON.
Third, a controlled experiment shows that the cut's real cost appears first as extra work, not as wrong answers: 43% more tool calls, twice the computation, and yield falling from 0.61 to 0.31.

highlights.title: Any3R: Feedforward 3D Reconstruction from Any Camera Type
highlights.authors: Jingong Chen, Qingwen Zhang, Youming Deng et al.
highlights.why: 通过以密集光线场为条件，消除了针孔相机假设，从而支持从任意中心相机进行前馈重建，这是一个重要的实际进步。
highlights.key_result: 因此，Any3R 是一种前馈模型，可以接受任何中心相机，并且对每个场景混合多种相机类型具有鲁棒性，无需针对每种镜头重新训练。在涵盖三个数据集、十三种中心相机的基准测试中，每个方法都使用自己预测的相机位姿进行重建，Any3R 是最稳定准确的方法。
evidence: Any3R is therefore a feed-forward model that takes any central camera, and is robust to mixing many camera types per scene, with no retraining per lens. On a benchmark of thirteen central cameras across three datasets, where every method reconstructs with its own predicted camera poses, it is the most consistently accurate method.

OpenAI expands partnership with Oracle to bring its apps to ChatGPT
news.summary: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and building new Oracle products on OpenAI models, including Oracle AI Workspace, AI Security Mesh, AI SMB Bundle, and App Composer. Oracle reported 130,000 active ChatGPT users and more than 95,000 active Codex users, and its recruiting team cut market research preparation from two to four days to 15–20 minutes; U.S. customers can buy OpenAI API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work access via Oracle Marketplace.

news.title: Genie 4: A new generation of world simulation
news.summary: Google DeepMind 发布了 Genie 4，这是一个原生多模态世界模型，在交互式模拟的同时生成音频、环境噪声和对话，基于 Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Omni）构建。它正作为研究预览版向受信任的测试者推出，首先面向 Project Genie 中的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者以及 Gemini API 和 Google AI Studio 的早期访问合作伙伴。

news.title: The sleep framework: A new way for LLMs to retain knowledge in continual learning
news.summary: Google Research 为持续学习引入了一个“睡眠”框架，其中 LLM 在主动清醒阶段和离线睡眠阶段之间交替，睡眠阶段通过 MoE 扩展、知识播种和自生成练习示例将短期上下文整合到参数中。作者报告，该方法使模型能够获取新事实，保留长达 10M token 的长上下文知识，并在缓解灾难性遗忘的同时提高推理能力。

news.title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
news.summary: NVIDIA describes its collaboration with C-BRAIN, a consortium of 18 institutions launched in November 2025 and led by Dr. Randall Bateman, which uses AI on previously inaccessible "dark data" for Alzheimer's research, running 64 NVIDIA data center GPUs on premises plus Azure cloud nodes, with Blackwell systems planned. C-BRAIN has built two tools, OpenScientist (with Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory) and InsightEngine (with 387 Labs), targeting the 57 million people living with dementia worldwide.

news.title: Memory-Enforced GPU Sharing in Kubernetes with NVIDIA CUDA 13.4
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了 gpu-fractioning，这是一个托管在 KAI Scheduler 组织下的开源 Kubernetes 操作器，它与 NVIDIA GPU Operator 一起运行，用于在每个节点上配置 MPS、应用按工作负载的内存限制和计算模式，并测量每个分片的用量。CUDA 13.4 增加了透明的内存边界强制执行，支持精确数量、保证最小/突发最大范围，并可在时间片或 sm-sharing 模式之间选择，并通过 KAI Scheduler v0.18.0 的 NvFractions 模式集成。

news.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Powers Neural Rendering and AI Characters in Games
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出了 RTX Spark，这是一个 Windows PC 平台，结合了 Blackwell RTX GPU 和 Grace CPU，配备高达 128 GB 的统一内存，面向轻薄笔记本电脑和紧凑型台式机中的 AI 开发、创作和游戏。它支持 DLSS 5 与 3D-Guided Neural Rendering，从 NBA 2K27 开始，这是一个十月模型更新，在 4K 下运行速度比九月快 2x，同时 VRAM 占用减少 20%，并支持用于本地 AI 角色的 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 模型。

news.title: Fine-Tuning NVIDIA Nemotron to Know Local Rules, Not Just Local Languages
news.summary: NVIDIA 发布了面向法国（与 Pleias 合作）和比利时（与 Pleias 和 KU Leuven 合作）的 Nemotron-Personas 数据集，这些合成居民基于区域人口统计和文化，是覆盖 12 个国家数据计划的一部分。随附的工作流生成合成对话，并在 NVIDIA NeMo 上使用 LoRA 对 Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 进行微调；Pleias 在其 Lamina 脊柱护理助手中使用了这些数据集。

news.title: 3 Ways to Boost MoE Inference on NVIDIA DGX Spark
news.summary: NVIDIA 对在 DGX Spark 上以 batch size 1 服务 Ling-3.0-flash（一个具有 124-billion 参数的 MoE 模型，每个 token 有 5.1 billion 个活跃参数）的三种优化进行了基准测试：Humming MXFP4 MoE 内核（每个输出 token 从 27.71 ms 降至 25.35 ms，提升 9.3%）、LM head 的在线 FP8 量化（与 Humming 结合后提升 21.7%），以及 NEXTN 推测解码（每轮接受 3.90 个 token，提升 185.1%）。在 GSM8K 上，它们共同将解码吞吐量提高了 42.5%，并将平均延迟降低了 24.5%，且没有统计上可检测的准确率变化。

news.title: Build specialized multimodal models with LFM3
news.summary: Liquid AI 的 LFM3 是新一代基础模型，涵盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态和决策模型，参数规模在 2B 范围内，全部基于 LFM3-1.7B-Base 训练而成，据报道 LFM3-1.7B 在使用少 35% 参数的情况下性能优于 LFM2.5-2.6B。该基础模型在 22T token 上预训练，具有 256K 上下文窗口，4-bit 下约占 1 GB，并且可以在单个 GPU 上微调；一个新的 164M 参数视觉编码器的 FLOPs 比 Qwen3.5-2B 的少 2.2x。

news.title: Can we trust LLMs to judge whether a research idea is novel?
news.summary: Ai2 发布了 Old Ideas, Novel Problems，这是一项研究和基准测试，用于检验 LLM 能否判断研究想法的新颖性，基于 ICLR 2026 同行评审构建成一个包含 154 个想法的高新颖性池和一个包含 145 个想法的较低新颖性池。在六个评判模型（GPT-5.1、GPT-5.2、GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Claude Opus 4.5、Claude Opus 4.6）中，提示词的微小变化使准确率改变了超过 50 个百分点，检索和额外推理并未持续带来帮助，并且两个专门构建的新颖性系统表现不如一个简单提示的 Claude Opus 4.6 基线。

news.title: AWS named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contact Center as a Service
news.summary: AWS 宣布 Amazon Connect 连续第四年在 2026 年 Gartner 联络中心即服务魔力象限中被评为领导者。该文章描述了 Connect Customer 使用生成式 AI 和智能体 AI 来获取客户背景和解决问题，并提供可审计的操作和人工转接。

news.title: Announcing SOCI-indexed images for faster SageMaker AI jobs
news.summary: AWS 宣布为 Amazon SageMaker AI Training 和 processing jobs 提供 Seekable OCI (SOCI) 索引，该索引以惰性方式加载容器镜像，使作业无需更改作业定义即可在几秒内而非几分钟内启动。在从 ml.g4dn 到 ml.p5 和 ml.m7i 的实例上对八个 1.8–35.4 GB 压缩镜像进行基准测试时，镜像拉取期间的 GPU 空闲时间最多下降了 90%。

news.title: Fix evaluation bias to unlock better models on Amazon Bedrock
news.summary: Property Finder 和 AWS Generative AI Innovation Center 描述了如何修复 Amazon Bedrock 上的评估偏差：96.8% 的评估标签来自现有视觉模型的预测，而非人工验证，从而扭曲了比较。在构建专家标注的真值（一个包含 256 张图像的开发集）并运行从 v0 到 v27 的提示优化后，他们报告以低 86% 的成本获得了更高的准确率。

news.title: Exowatt beats frontier models on accuracy with SageMaker serverless model customization
news.summary: Exowatt 使用 Amazon SageMaker AI 无服务器模型定制构建了一个可重复的流水线，为边缘和云端警报分类生成任务特定的微调模型，报告准确率高于前沿模型，且成本最多降低 49x。该流水线将原始运营数据转换为经认证的训练集、微调模型和经过评估的部署产物，现在可在数天而非数月内完成。
